# Burrow v0.2.0 — Smart Scan & Recoverable Care

Burrow v0.2.0 brings the main maintenance workflows together while making
cleanup safer and easier to understand. 🐹

## Highlights

- **✨ Smart Scan** combines cleanup, a focused ClamAV security scan and
  context-aware maintenance recommendations.
- **🗺️ Disk treemap** turns storage usage into an interactive visual map with
  directory drill-down.
- **📊 Menu-bar widget** keeps CPU, memory, disk, temperature and GPU status
  visible and provides shortcuts to Smart Scan and activity history.
- **📜 Activity journal** records important local operations in one private,
  size-bounded history.
- **↩️ Recoverable cleanup** moves user data and removed applications to the
  macOS Trash so they can be restored from Finder.
- **✂️ Universal binary thinning** can reclaim Intel slices from compatible
  application bundles while keeping the original application in the Trash.

## Platform

- macOS 13 Ventura or later
- Apple Silicon only (`arm64`)

## Integrity

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and CycloneDX dependency inventories.
See `SHA256SUMS` in the downloadable artifacts before installation.

Burrow remains pre-1.0 software. Review the proposed actions and keep current
backups before using maintenance features on important data.
